headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 27, 2026**
article:
The Miami Marlins fell short in Toronto, with Kazuma Okamoto leading the offense. Okamoto hit his 11th home run of the season. The Washington Nationals also dropped a decision, unable to overcome a late-game deficit. CJ Abrams led the Nationals with 2 hits. The Seattle Mariners cruised past the Oakland Athletics 9-1 behind a strong performance from Logan Gilbert.

Several players have been impacted by injuries. Enrique Hernández has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left oblique strain. Nolan Schanuel has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to May 24, 2026, with left ankle inflammation. Gavin Lux has been placed on the 60-day injured list with right shoulder impingement.

The Detroit Tigers made a move, acquiring left-handed pitcher Juanmi Vasquez from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for right-handed pitcher Connor Seabold.

top_news.title: **Marlins Fall Short in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins dropped a 1-2 decision to the Toronto Blue Jays, with Kazuma Okamoto leading the Marlins' offense. Okamoto hit his 11th home run of the season, a fly ball to right center field.

top_news.title: **Nationals Fall Short in Cleveland**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals dropped a 2-3 decision to the Cleveland Guardians, unable to overcome a late-game deficit. CJ Abrams led the Nationals with 2 hits, while Gavin Williams earned the win for the Guardians with 7 strong innings.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall Short in Milwaukee**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals dropped a 1-2 decision to the Milwaukee Brewers, failing to secure a win on the road. Bryan Torres led the Cardinals' offense with a single, one RBI, and four at-bats.

top_news.title: **Mariners Cruise Past Athletics 9-1**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners dominated the Oakland Athletics, securing a 9-1 victory behind a strong performance from Logan Gilbert. Gilbert pitched 6.0 innings, striking out 6 batters and allowing 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Place Enrique Hernández on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Dodgers first baseman Enrique Hernández has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left oblique strain. The injury occurred on May 27, 2026.

top_news.title: **Tigers Acquire LHP Juanmi Vasquez in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers made a move on May 27, 2026, acquiring left-handed pitcher Juanmi Vasquez from the Toronto Blue Jays. In exchange, the Tigers traded right-handed pitcher Connor Seabold to the Blue Jays.
